c: On the incident, open More actions and choose Copy Incident. Agents with itil see it, in any state.
say: On the incident, open more actions and choose copy incident. Support agents see it on any incident, even a closed one.

c: The dialog asks for the Caller of the new incident. It is required.
say: The dialog asks who the caller of the new incident is. You must fill it in.

c: If the incident has attachments, Include attachments is shown, ticked. Untick it if the new caller shouldn't get them.
say: If the incident has attachments, include attachments is shown and ticked. Untick it if the new caller should not get them.

c: Choose Copy. The new incident is saved straight away with the description, category, configuration item, group and priority, and opens.
say: Choose copy. The new incident is saved straight away, with the description, category, configuration item, group and priority, and it opens.

c: Its only link to the original is a work note: This Incident is copied from INC…. It is not a child incident.
say: Its only link back to the original is a work note saying which incident it was copied from. It is not a child incident.

c: The assignee, state, notes and watch list are not copied. Check the new incident before you work on it.
say: The assignee, the state, the notes and the watch list are not copied. Check the new incident before you work on it.
